756660101.text: Whoo! I think that's everything in order... Can't shake the feeling that something's missing, though...

756660102.text: #Well, hello, {NICKNAME}! You're just in time. Up for a game of graffiti spray?

756660105.text: Haha, there's no need to sound so nervous. It's just a game!

756660106.text: And in a game, no one gets hurt — at least not on my watch! I can't promise your clothes won't get a little messy, though.

756660107.text: I'm not very good when it comes to spraying graffiti...

756660108.text: Excuses, schmexcuses! C'mon, this game's good for even absolute rock-bottom beginners. Just start spraying and you'll have a blast!

756660109.text: The truth is, I was brought in to create something big, bold, and awe-inspiring to serve as a spray-painting subject...

756660110.text: Well, let's just say, while I did deliver something pretty epic, not everyone has the painting chops to do it justice.

756660111.text: So I did what any great artist would — I simplified the brief and placed more focus on the "process" of painting.

756660112.text: Simply put, I guess it's like... Hmm... Okay, I don't know how to put it simply. Let's just say, you'll understand once you try!

756660113.text: And by "try," I mean it's your turn to get out there and start making some art!
